standard_rag.answer:
Rapid Application Development (RAD) is a set of tools and techniques used to build applications faster than is typically possible with traditional methods. It often utilizes software prototyping and iterational development to implement design and user requirements incrementally.

(File: OOAD_CAT_I_StudyMaterial.pdf, Page: 79)
